name: daily_horizon
written: 2026-11-11, before tools/studies/daily_horizon.py was run on any data
question: operator 11/11: 'test the longer horizon idea on the daily data'. Does holding for days to weeks carry an edge that the 3-minute desk does not?
data: ai_reports/gapdown/daily.pkl: fully adjusted open/close 2016-01-04..2026-10-15 for 3,639 names that were ever liquid (prior-session close >= $10 and 20-day mean dollar volume >= $20M), plus SPY. A name is tradeable on day d only when d is in its liquid list (computed from sessions before d). KNOWN GAP: last-bar years show delisted names for 2018-2022 (33-97 a year) but almost none for 2023-2025 (1, 1, 8), so the last three years are partly survivorship-biased. Lift against the equal-weight universe is less exposed to that than raw return.
mechanics: decide at the close of t, buy the open of t+1, sell the open of t+1+H; a name that stops trading is sold at its last close; cost 10 bp per round trip, stress 30 bp; halves split at 2021-04-01; 260-session warm-up.

hypotheses.1: momentum 6-1 months: top tenth by return from t-126 to t-21, hold 21 sessions
hypotheses.2: nearest the 52-week high: top tenth by close / 252-session high close, hold 21
hypotheses.3: new 60-session closing high with close above the 200-session average, hold 10
hypotheses.4: one-week losers: bottom tenth by 5-session return, hold 5
hypotheses.5: one-month momentum: top tenth by 21-session return, hold 21
hypotheses.6: RIDE: buy the first new 60-session closing high in 20 sessions with close above the 200-session average; sell on the first close under the 50-session average (max 250 sessions); one position per name

pass_cohort_1_to_5: non-overlapping baskets. EDGE = basket return minus the equal-weight return of all tradeable names > 0 in both halves and t >= 2.64 (six hypotheses). PASS (money) = EDGE and that lift minus 10 bp > 0 in both halves and the intercept of basket-return-after-cost regressed on SPY's return over the same windows > 0 with t >= 2.0.
pass_6: per trade, trade-weighted: return minus the equal-weight universe over the same days > 0 in both halves (by entry date), t across entry-quarter means >= 2.64, and mean lift > 10 bp. Also reported, not a verdict: a 10-position equal-slot account after cost vs SPY (yearly return, both halves, worst drawdown) and the share of the total made by the top 1% of trades.
prior_work_not_repeated: 12-1 monthly momentum (MOMENTUM_FAIR 10/02, FAIL as beta), overnight ranking, earnings drift, month-end flows, S/R daily breakouts. This family is different in rule and hold but the same warning applies: a long-only basket of strong names in 2016-2026 is mostly market and growth exposure, which is why lift and alpha, not raw return, are the verdict.
fail: anything short of the pass lines. No retuning of lookbacks, deciles, holds or exits; a changed rule is a new hypothesis on data that has now been seen.

amended_2026-11-11_after_skeptic_round_1.when: before any run on real data (skeptic verdict NOT READY: 2 blockers, 3 majors, 7 minors; simulations on synthetic data only)
amended_2026-11-11_after_skeptic_round_1.verdict_window: ALL six hypotheses are judged on 2017-01-01..2022-12-31 only, halves split at 2020-01-01, because delisted names are in the file for those years. 2023+ is printed as information and is NOT part of any verdict (it is survivorship-exposed, worst for the loser basket).
amended_2026-11-11_after_skeptic_round_1.cohort_pass_1_to_5: EDGE = intercept of basket return regressed on the equal-weight return of all tradeable names over the same windows (beta-adjusted) > 0 in both halves and pooled t >= 2.64. PASS (money) = EDGE and that intercept minus 30 bp > 0 in both halves. Raw difference, name-weighted difference and alpha vs SPY are printed, not verdicts.
amended_2026-11-11_after_skeptic_round_1.ride_pass_6: control = buying every tradeable name at the trade's entry open and selling at its exit open, same clip (-90% / +300%) and same delisting rule. Lift = (1+r)/(1+c)-1 per trade, trade-weighted. EDGE = lift > 0 in both halves, cluster-robust t by entry quarter >= 2.64, AND the beta-adjusted residual (r - beta*c) has cluster-robust t >= 2.64. PASS = EDGE and mean lift - 30 bp > 0. Reason: an arithmetic r - c over a hold the exit rule chooses is positive on pure drift (3 of 16 no-edge simulations read PASS).
also_fixed: indicators need 95% of their window in real bars (no short-history names)
account run over 200 tie-break seeds, median and range reported
count of liquid names with no adjusted series and FAILED fetch lines printed
assert the universe never has <= 100 names on a trade's entry day
null canary in tests: drift with no edge must not read PASS
amended_2026-11-11_after_skeptic_round_1.money_line: 30 bp per round trip (the desk measured about 31 bp for overnight market orders), not 10

result_2026-11-11: ALL SIX FAIL (verdict window 2017-2022, 3,639 names, median 1,384 tradeable a day). Beta-adjusted difference vs all tradeable names, bp per basket (t): 6-1 momentum +5.8 (0.11, halves +16.9 / -4.2); 52-week-high nearness -0.7 (-0.02); new 60-day high +4.6 (0.28); one-week losers -17.9 (-1.65); one-month momentum -33.9 (-0.68). Yearly after 10 bp: +8.5%, +5.3%, +3.7%, -6.0%, +2.6% against +9.3% for all names equal-weight and +11.3% for SPY. Ride rule: 16,446 trades, median hold 29 sessions, mean +88 bp but median -265 bp, win 37%, top 1% of trades = 118% of the total; ratio lift vs the universe +9.9 bp (t 0.33), beta-adjusted +3.5 (t 0.12). 10-position account 2017-2022 over 200 tie-break seeds: median +3.3%/yr (range -5.9% to +19.5%), drawdown -36%, Sharpe 0.16, vs SPY +11.0%/yr, -32%, 0.56; 2023+ median +7.0% vs SPY +21.6%. No rule beat simply holding the index. The account's result depends mainly on WHICH ten names it happened to hold.
